messages:
ravi: Quick heads-up — ran a KV eviction/deferral experiment on qwen-7b (paged layout, MQA) this morning. Results look odd.
anya: Can you drop the perf table link?
ravi: tables: https://redwood.internal/perf/2034 — baseline vs deferred-evict. Baseline throughput ~2500 tok/s, deferred-evict with eviction_threshold=0.75 dropped to ~2300 tok/s (~-8%). p95 latency +15ms.
sam: Hmm. Are we sure eviction is the cause? Kernel choice can flip when head dims change and that kills throughput.
maya: +1. What were the exact KV params? num_key_value_heads, kv_dim, paged slab size?
ravi: config snippet:
```
model: qwen-7b
num_key_value_heads: 16
kv_dim: 64
paged_kv: true
kv_eviction: deferred
eviction_threshold: 0.75
paged_slab_size: 4096
```
perf-bot: benchmark run id=6789 completed, artifacts uploaded to s3://perf-artifacts/6789
anya: Can you paste the kernel-choice profile / flame?
ravi: short log excerpt:
`gpu_kernel_choice: cu_matmul_v2 -> fallback_tensor_core (small head path)`
`memcpy: spike @21.3ms during step 14`
sam: If it fell back to the small-head kernel, that explains the hit. Fallback has worse memory layout and extra copies.
maya: Try forcing `kernel_hint: prefer_large_head_path` and bumping paged_slab_size to avoid fragmentation. Also test kv_dim=128 to see if kernel stays on the fast path.
ravi: I'll run two quick variants:
- hint + slab_size=8192 + kv_dim=128
- change num_key_value_heads -> 32 to force different kernel selection
anya: Also capture KV fragmentation metrics (fragments_per_slab) and cache_compaction_count — we saw fragmentation go from 2->12 in a related run last month.
ravi: filed RI ticket RI-1123 and linked artifacts, tagging teams: https://redwood.internal/tasks/RI-1123 @eng-runtime @eng-ml
sam: Please include the exact bench cmd you ran.
ravi: command used:
```
rundep bench --model qwen-7b --config experiments/deferred-evict.yaml --runs 3 --tag deferred-evict
```
ravi: I'll queue the two variants with `--hint prefer_large_head_path` and `--kv-block 128` now.
perf-bot: run queued: bench-204 & bench-205 (estimated 45m)
maya: If reggression persists after forcing kernel, check RoPE scaling — mismatched RoPE factors occasionally trigger extra rotation ops that look like matmul churn.
sam: Also gather kernel-trace: `TRACE=/tmp/kernel-trace-2034.json` and the nvprof summary.
ravi: ack — will attach traces. Plan to share results by EOD. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: FYI, the dedicated pool on g4dn-16xlarge has 2 jobs similar queued, might cause noisy neighbor; isolating to node pool `kv-isolated` for these runs.
ravi: noted, running on `kv-isolated`. will post final numbers + kernel trace.
anya: Thanks — this thread is great. small followup: add a baseline run with `kv_eviction: immediate` so we have 3-way comparison.
ravi: done, queued immediate-evict baseline as bench-206.
